user.title: Set up Energy Ledger
user.description: Energy Ledger reads your own power and price entities to keep a running cost, compensation and net balance — it doesn't scrape anything external or control your inverter/battery.

data.home_load_power_entity: Total home load power sensor (W, optional)
data.grid_import_energy_entity: Real import energy meter sensor (kWh, optional)

data_description.grid_power_entity: E.g. sensor.goodwe_meter_active_power_total. Positive/negative according to the toggle below.
data_description.positive_is_export: Turn this off if your sensor uses the opposite convention (positive = importing).
data_description.buy_price_entity: The real-time price you pay for every kWh imported from the grid.
data_description.sell_price_entity: Leave empty if you aren't compensated for surplus: compensation and balance won't be tracked.
data_description.home_load_power_entity: Needed for the self-consumption savings sensor. Leave empty to skip it.
data_description.grid_import_energy_entity: If you have a real meter (e.g. from your own inverter), the home's kWh comes from it instead of being rebuilt from power — more accurate. Leave empty to keep using integrated power.

user.title: Add circuit
user.description: An extra circuit you want to track besides the house total, e.g. a water heater or a washing machine.
